name: Astronomical telescope on tripod

parts.name: optical tube
parts.massBasis: Optical tube assembly is a thin-walled cylindrical shell (aluminum or carbon fiber) with primary/secondary mirrors and focuser. Four materials indicate tube wall, mirror cell, focuser, and dew shield. Radial variance slightly above 1/12 due to shell mass at outer radius; axial variance near uniform. Hollow construction keeps mass well below solid-box density.

parts.name: tripod
parts.massBasis: Tripod consists of three hollow tubular legs (aluminum or steel), a center spreader, and rubber/metal feet. Four materials map to legs, spreader, feet, and top plate. Mass distributed along slender legs spreading outward and downward; CoM below geometric center. Higher x/z variance from leg splay, lower y variance from legs being thin tubes along mostly-vertical direction.
